_meta.model: 12 continuous dimensions in 6 pairs / 3 clusters (Quantic-Foundry-shaped; N=466k v2.3 2023-2025 is the citable base). Motivations are CONTINUOUS INDEPENDENT DIMENSIONS - discrete 'types' are presentation sugar (Yee 2006 refuted type suppression; every psychometric audit agrees). Trojan Player Typology (2015) is the behaviorally validated cross-check (N=18.6k LoL + 18.8k MMO telemetry).
_meta.instruments: BANGS (2024, open access) for SDT needs incl. frustration; PXI for experience; PENS proprietary - never bundle; GEQ unvalidated - banned

findings.finding: competition declines most with age (steepest 13->35); age explains >2x gender's variance
strategy is the most age-stable motivation
female share by genre spans Match-3 ~69% <-> tactical shooter ~4%
shooters trade competition <-> story along subgenre lines
SDT: competence/autonomy/relatedness satisfaction predicts enjoyment and continued play; levers = masterable controls, clear feedback, goal/strategy choice, opt-in co-op
social ties are the strongest multiplayer retention mechanism; retention drivers shift achievement-early -> social-late
purchases are predicted by unobstructed play + social interaction + economical rationale, not generic engagement
motivational QUALITY beats playtime for well-being
players are overwhelmingly negative on gen-AI content, varying by profile

dedicated.note: top-decile playtime; also the binge-risk band - care, not upsells
